Title: GTA V Enhanced Font Patcher
Subtitle: Add missing game glyphs
Hint: Exit the game first. Resources are backed up automatically.
Ready: Choose the game folder, then select Patch fonts.
ChooseFolder: Choose the GTA V Enhanced folder
SelectGame: Select the Enhanced game folder containing GTA5_Enhanced.exe.
MissingLoader: Missing {0}. Install OpenRPF 0.3 and the Enhanced ASI Loader.
NeedStory: Add -nobattleye to args.txt in the game folder and use Story Mode.
OutdatedMods: The mods archive is from a different game version. Back up old mods and use current resources.
AlreadyPatched: All available game glyphs are already installed.
ChangedFiles: Game files changed. Run the tool again.
RestoreChanged: Game resources were updated or modified. Restore was stopped.
DirectDisabled: Use OpenRPF to install fonts in the mods folder.
WorkExists: Output already exists. Choose an empty work folder.
MissingCharacter: The {0} font is missing U+{1}. Verify the game files.
CheckSources: Checking source glyphs and all 13 languages…
WriteFonts: Building and checking the font archive…
